object_reference_bank_binding.binding_id: Unique object reference bank binding record identifier.
object_reference_bank_binding.object_id: Canonical object identifier from reference bank.
object_reference_bank_binding.identity_signature: Hash of object identity anchors and identity_level from reference bank entry.

object_anchor_binding.binding_id: Unique object anchor binding record identifier.

object_memory_binding.binding_id: Unique object memory binding record identifier.
object_memory_binding.scene_id: Scene identifier binding memory entry to spatial graph scene.
object_memory_binding.memory_signature: Hash of object_anchors persisted across shots.
object_memory_binding.object_anchor_reuse: Boolean flag indicating anchor reused from reference bank entry.
object_memory_binding.identity_level: Identity lock enum: strict | medium | loose.
object_memory_binding.persistence_score: Cross-shot object anchor stability score in [0,1].

object_traceability_binding.binding_id: Unique object traceability binding record identifier.
object_traceability_binding.identity_embedding_ref: Reserved IP-Adapter identity embedding path (metadata placeholder).
object_traceability_binding.traceability_signature: Deterministic hash binding all lineage fields.

object_retrieval_binding.binding_id: Unique object retrieval binding record identifier.
object_retrieval_binding.fallback_keys: Ordered fallback key fields for retrieval.

object_variation_tolerance_binding.binding_id: Unique object variation tolerance binding record identifier.
object_variation_tolerance_binding.identity_level: Identity lock enum: strict | medium | loose.

object_similarity_binding.binding_id: Unique object similarity binding record identifier.
object_similarity_binding.object_id: Target object identifier for similarity matching.
object_similarity_binding.identity_signature: Identity signature hash used for similarity comparison.
object_similarity_binding.similarity_threshold: Minimum score to treat objects as similar (not identical).
object_similarity_binding.same_object_threshold: Minimum score required for same-object identity lock.
object_similarity_binding.matching_features: Feature list used in similarity rank (anchor_kind, importance, identity_signature).

object_role_binding.binding_id: Unique object role binding record identifier.
object_role_binding.object_role: Narrative role enum: hero_prop | background_furniture | scene_prop | environment_prop.
object_role_binding.role_weight: Narrative lock weight derived from object role priority.
object_role_binding.narrative_lock: Boolean flag indicating role requires narrative-preserving identity lock.

similarity_matching_strategy.note: Similar Object != Same Object — scores below same_object_threshold must not be treated as identity lock.

variation_tolerance_strategy.note: Variation Tolerance must be evaluated separately from identity — lock_strength derives from tolerance band, not similarity score.

role_binding_strategy.note: Object Role must be evaluated separately from similarity — role governs narrative lock weight, not visual match score.
